themes.name: 上課用語
themes.intro: 今天是開學第一天！主角在校門口遇到同學，他們在說什麼呢？

turns.speaker: classmate
turns.indigenousText: O cima ko ngangan no miso?

turns.speaker: protagonist
turns.indigenousText: Ci Kacaw ko ngangan no mako.

turns.speaker: classmate
turns.indigenousText: I cowaay ko loma’ no miso?

turns.speaker: protagonist
turns.indigenousText: O naiAncohay a niyaro’ kako a tayni.

turns.speaker: classmate
turns.indigenousText: Maranamay to kiso haw?

turns.speaker: protagonist
turns.indigenousText: Cowa ho!

turns.speaker: classmate
turns.indigenousText: O mami’aca kako to sakaranam, mihakelong kiso tayra haw?
turns.chineseText: 我要去買早餐，要一起去嗎？

turns.speaker: protagonist
turns.indigenousText: Awaay ko miolongan ako a payci, nga’ay pacaliwen iso kako to payci haw?
turns.chineseText: 我沒有帶錢。你可以借我錢嗎？

turns.speaker: classmate
turns.indigenousText: Nga’ay to, pacaliwen ako kiso.

quests.quest: 你今天第一天上學，趕快認識你旁邊的兩位同學吧！
quests.tips: 問他們：「你叫甚麼名字？」，將名牌放到同學的桌上吧！

lines.indigenousText: o cima ko ngangan no miso
lines.displayText: O cima ko ngangan no miso?

reply.indigenousText: Ci Kacaw ko ngangan no mako.

lines.indigenousText: o cima ko ngangan no miso
lines.displayText: O cima ko ngangan no miso?

reply.indigenousText: Si Panay ko ngangan no mako.

quests.quest: 很好，現在你認識了同學的名字，
quests.tips: 再問問他們：「你家住哪裡？」吧！

lines.indigenousText: i cowaay ko loma’ no miso
lines.displayText: I cowaay ko loma’ no miso?

reply.indigenousText: I Dikidikiay ko loma’ no mako.

lines.indigenousText: i cowaay ko loma’ no miso
lines.displayText: I cowaay ko loma’ no miso?

reply.indigenousText: I Kaloloanay ko loma’ no mako.

quests.quest: 上課了，老師請你們寫筆記。你忘記帶筆了，同學好像有多的筆。
quests.tips: 快想想辦法，問「（同學名字），借我筆好嗎？」，請同學借你吧！

lines.indigenousText: Kacaw nga’ay pacaliwen iso kako to impic haw
lines.displayText: Kacaw, nga’ay pacaliwen iso kako to impic haw?

reply.indigenousText: Hayda, pacaliwen ako kiso.

lines.indigenousText: Panay nga’ay pacaliwen iso kako to impic haw
lines.displayText: Panay, nga’ay pacaliwen iso kako to impic haw?

reply.indigenousText: Cecayay ko no mako.

quests.quest: 你不小心寫錯字了，需要橡皮擦，但發現忘了帶。
quests.tips: 快想想辦法，問「（同學名字），借我橡皮擦好嗎？」，請同學借你吧！

lines.indigenousText: Kacaw nga’ay pacaliwen iso kako to sasipasip haw
lines.displayText: Kacaw, nga’ay pacaliwen iso kako to sasipasip haw?

reply.indigenousText: Awaay haca ko no mako.

lines.indigenousText: Panay nga’ay pacaliwen iso kako to sasipasip haw
lines.displayText: Panay, nga’ay pacaliwen iso kako to sasipasip haw?

reply.indigenousText: Hayda, alaen.

quests.quest: 老師分配你掃地工作，掃把在你同學旁邊．
quests.tips: 跟同學說「（同學名字），請幫我拿掃把。」，請同學拿給你吧！

lines.indigenousText: Kacaw pacafayen ho kako a miala to saasik
lines.displayText: Kacaw, pacafayen ho kako a miala to saasik.

reply.indigenousText: Hayda, na, hano miso koni saasik.

lines.indigenousText: Panay pacafayen ho kako a miala to saasik
lines.displayText: Panay, pacafayen ho kako a miala to saasik.

reply.indigenousText: Cowa kafana’ kako to icowaay?

themes.name: 尋找物品
themes.intro: 今天家裡要辦婚禮，很多親戚都來了。看到大家忙得不可開交，主角決定要幫大家一起準備。

turns.speaker: classmate
turns.indigenousText: Ina, aloman ko tayniay loma’ a salawinawina haw!
turns.chineseText: 媽媽今天家裡來了好多親戚哦！

turns.speaker: mother
turns.indigenousText: O pipakayifan no fa’inayan a kaka anini, mansa aloman ko tayniay a tamdaw.
turns.chineseText: 今天是哥哥的婚禮，所以有很多人來。

turns.speaker: classmate
turns.indigenousText: Kahemekan to ! Halafinay to caka araw sa mira.
turns.chineseText: 好開心喔！很久沒有看到他們了！

turns.speaker: mother
turns.indigenousText: Hayi ! Matayal maemin kita anini, pacafay ko miso to alomanay.
turns.chineseText: 對啊！今天大家都會很忙，你要幫忙大家。

turns.speaker: classmate
turns.indigenousText: Hay ! Pacafay to kako!

turns.speaker: mother
turns.indigenousText: Milikakawa ho kako to sakadademak anosawni
turns.chineseText: 我要去準備等一下要用的東西了。

turns.speaker: classmate
turns.indigenousText: Mipacafay kako!

turns.speaker: mother
turns.indigenousText: Hay, tool han to iso kako!

quests.quest: 媽媽把陶壺搞混了，請你幫忙找出新訂做的陶壺。
quests.tips: 去問問看「新的陶壺長怎樣？」，找出陶壺吧！

lines.indigenousText: samaanay a nengnengen ko atomo
lines.displayText: Samaanay a nengnengen ko atomo?

reply.indigenousText: Mitanokiradoman ako a mitafo.

lines.indigenousText: samaanay a nengnengen ko atomo
lines.displayText: Samaanay a nengnengen ko atomo?

reply.indigenousText: Mitanokahengangay a kiradom a tafoen ni ina.

lines.indigenousText: samaanay a nengnengen ko atomo
lines.displayText: Samaanay a nengnengen ko atomo?

reply.indigenousText: Cowa to kaharateng ako.

quests.quest: 阿嬤在包cinavu，發現月桃葉不夠了，請你去採。
quests.tips: 趕快去問問看「哪裡有月桃？」，採一些放到籃子裡吧！

lines.indigenousText: iraay icowa ko lengac
lines.displayText: Iraay icowa ko lengac?

reply.indigenousText: Ca kafana’ kako.

lines.indigenousText: iraay icowa ko lengac
lines.displayText: Iraay icowa ko lengac?

reply.indigenousText: I tokotokosan nga iraay.

lines.indigenousText: iraay icowa ko lengac
lines.displayText: Iraay icowa ko lengac?

reply.indigenousText: Ira ko osaw ako, na hamiso.

quests.quest: 爸爸在點聘禮的數量，發現檳榔數量不對。
quests.tips: 趕快問問看其他人「你有看到檳榔嗎？」，找出檳榔，把它們放在一起吧！

lines.indigenousText: manengnengay iso ko ’icep haw
lines.displayText: Manengnengay iso ko ’icep haw?

reply.indigenousText: Awaay itini i kakoanan.

lines.indigenousText: manengnengay iso ko ’icep haw
lines.displayText: Manengnengay iso ko ’icep haw?

reply.indigenousText: Iraay, i kafekangay no hakenang.

lines.indigenousText: manengnengay iso ko ’icep haw
lines.displayText: Manengnengay iso ko ’icep haw?

reply.indigenousText: Iraay tora tisaki.

quests.quest: 婚禮快要開始了，親友們都在門外準備。
quests.tips: 咦，哥哥怎麼不見了？快點問問看「哥哥在哪裡？」，把哥哥找出來吧！

lines.indigenousText: icowaay si kaka
lines.displayText: Icowaay si kaka?

reply.indigenousText: Awaay a maaraw, talacowaay ko mira?

lines.indigenousText: icowaay si kaka
lines.displayText: Icowaay si kaka?

reply.indigenousText: Cowa ho kasadak ko mira haw?

lines.indigenousText: icowaay si kaka
lines.displayText: Icowaay si kaka?

reply.indigenousText: Awaay a maaraw han ? Kalikien a mikilim cingra!

quests.quest: 忙了一輪，終於一切就緒。婚禮要開始了，快點出發吧！

goal.endText: 忙了一輪，終於一切就緒。婚禮要開始了，快點出發吧！

themes.name: 戶外活動
themes.intro: 今天是星期六。主角正在和哥哥聊天，討論明天的行程。來看看他們要去哪裡玩吧！

turns.speaker: protagonist
turns.indigenousText: Alang, o paaliwacan to anocila, sakatalacowaaw kiso?
turns.chineseText: Alang，明天是星期天，你打算去哪裡？

turns.speaker: sibling
turns.indigenousText: Tatala’alo kako aci Miding mi’id’id to titi, kiso i?
turns.chineseText: 我明天要和Miding去溪邊烤肉，你呢？

turns.speaker: protagonist
turns.indigenousText: Hato nga’ayay salamaen a tengilaen! Manga’ay kako a mihakelong tayra haw?
turns.chineseText: 聽起來很好玩！我也可以一起去嗎？

turns.speaker: sibling
turns.indigenousText: Licayen ho iso ko wina i ka’ayaw a!

turns.speaker: protagonist
turns.indigenousText: Ina, manga’ay kako a mihakelong si kakaan tala’alo haw?
turns.chineseText: 媽媽，我可以跟哥哥一起去溪邊嗎？

turns.speaker: mother
turns.indigenousText: Hayda, nikaorira kapina’on to kamo yo!

turns.speaker: protagonist
turns.indigenousText: Hay mafana’ to, na’onen to niyam!

quests.quest: 公車快要來了，但你們還沒買食材和工具。
quests.tips: 問問看其他人「你要找什麼？」，檢視購物清單，找出還沒買到的東西，點選物品把它們放進購物籃吧！

lines.indigenousText: o maan ko mikiliman iso
lines.displayText: O maan ko mikiliman iso?

reply.indigenousText: Milkilimay kako to atang ato satapay.

lines.indigenousText: o maan ko mikiliman iso
lines.displayText: O maan ko mikiliman iso?

reply.indigenousText: Milkilimay kako to ariray ato konga.

quests.quest: 你們提早了一站下車，不知道該往哪走。
quests.tips: 哥哥請你幫忙詢問路人「溪邊要往哪裡走？」。趕快找出往溪邊的路吧！

lines.indigenousText: pasicowa ko rakat a tayra i ’alo
lines.displayText: Pasicowa ko rakat a tayra i ’alo?

reply.indigenousText: Iraw, pasitira tora ta’angayay a fakeloh.

lines.indigenousText: pasicowa ko rakat a tayra i ’alo
lines.displayText: Pasicowa ko rakat a tayra i ’alo?

reply.indigenousText: Cowa kafana’ kako to icowaay ko ’alo.

lines.indigenousText: pasicowa ko rakat a tayra i ’alo
lines.displayText: Pasicowa ko rakat a tayra i ’alo?

reply.indigenousText: Itini, isawniay ho kako minokay nai’alo.

quests.quest: 你正準備切菜，卻發現沒有刀子。
quests.tips: 去問看看其他人「可以借我刀子嗎？」，別忘了和對方說「謝謝你的幫忙！」喔！

lines.indigenousText: manga’ay a pacaliwen kako to po’ot haw
lines.displayText: Manga’ay a pacaliwen kako to po’ot haw?

reply.indigenousText: Hayda, alaen!

lines.indigenousText: manga’ay a pacaliwen kako to po’ot haw
lines.displayText: Manga’ay a pacaliwen kako to po’ot haw?

reply.indigenousText: Awaay haca ko no mako.

lines.indigenousText: manga’ay a pacaliwen kako to po’ot haw
lines.displayText: Manga’ay a pacaliwen kako to po’ot haw?

reply.indigenousText: Ca kanga’ay, matatasay ko po’ot ako.

quests.quest: 太陽下山了！你們今天都玩得很開心，還約好下次要再一起去溪邊玩。趕快回家吧！

goal.endText: 太陽下山了！你們今天都玩得很開心，還約好下次要再一起去溪邊玩。趕快回家吧！
